serverInfo.description: Search and browse Creative Market's catalog of fonts, graphics, templates, photos, 3D assets, illustrations, icons and mockups, with prices and links to purchase.
serverInfo.name: pointguard-mcp
serverInfo.title: Creative Market

tools.description: Search the Creative Market catalog of fonts, graphics, templates, photos, 3D assets, illustrations, icons, mockups and stock video by keyword, style, mood or subject, e.g. 'retro display fonts for a vinyl record label'. Supports category, price range, staff-pick, on-sale, featured and recency filters, font width and weight filters, asset property filters such as vector, layered, web font and orientation, pagination, and sorting by best_match (relevance), popular, newest, trending, staff_pick, price_asc or price_desc. Each result includes the product title, starting price, thumbnail image, shop, category and product link, and the response carries a licensing note. Assets marked AI-generated are excluded.

query.description: Natural language search query (e.g. 'hand-lettered script fonts for wedding invitations')

categories.description: Filter by category IDs. Top-level: Graphics=1, Templates=2, Fonts=3, Add-ons=4, Photos=6, 3D=7, Stock Video=8, Illustrations=23, Icons=26, Mockups=1800. Font subcategories: Serif=80, Sans-Serif=81, Script=82, Handwritten=88, Blackletter=85.

sort_by.description: How to sort results. Default: best_match

size.description: Number of results, 1-100. Default 12. Requests below 9 are raised to 9.

include_images.description: Attach each product's thumbnail as an image block. Default true.

width.description: Font widths: condensed, normal, wide, monospaced. Multi-select is AND: a font family must offer every listed width. Any value restricts results to fonts.

weight.description: Font weights: light, regular, bold, heavy. Multi-select is AND: a font family must offer every listed weight. Any value restricts results to fonts.

properties.description: Asset properties; multi-select is OR, any listed property matches: vector, raster, layered, tileable, web_font, layout_fluid, layout_fixed, layout_responsive, landscape, portrait, square, industry_film, industry_games, industry_design.

max_days_age.description: Only products published within this many days, 1-3650. The newest sort applies 15 when this is unset.

annotations.title: Identify a font from an image

tools.description: Identify the font in an image of text, such as a screenshot, photo, logo or design whose typeface is unknown, and return the closest matching Creative Market font products. Takes a public image URL or base64 image data, detects the letter shapes, reads the text, and matches the shapes against the Creative Market font catalog. Each result includes the product title, starting price, thumbnail image, shop, category and product link, in closest-match order, and the response carries a licensing note. Works best on a crop of a few clear, separated letters on a plain background; connected script letters, low-resolution images and busy backgrounds match poorly. When the text cannot be read automatically, the optional `text` argument supplies the letters shown, left to right, one character per detected shape. Assets marked AI-generated are excluded.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of a JPEG or PNG image containing text. Provide this or image_data.

image_data.description: Base64-encoded JPEG or PNG image data, up to 4 MB decoded. Provide this or image_url.

text.description: The letters shown in the image, left to right; spaces are ignored. Optional, for images whose text cannot be read automatically. Must have exactly one character per detected letter shape.

size.description: Number of matching fonts, 1-50. Default 12. Requests below 9 are raised to 9.

include_images.description: Attach each product's thumbnail as an image block. Default true.
